features.substep: HorizontalPodAutoscaler — CPU/memory-based, min/maxReplicas per component
features.blocking_gap: No HPA generated. Deployments run at fixed replica count with no autoscaling. Production workloads will not scale under load.
features.remediation: Add HPA doc per Deployment/StatefulSet component when hpa field is present (minReplicas, maxReplicas, targetCPUUtilizationPercentage). Skip CronJob/Job/DaemonSet. Add test_hpa_generated_for_deployment_with_hpa_config.

features.substep: PodDisruptionBudget — minAvailable per component for rolling upgrade safety
features.blocking_gap: No PDB generated. Node drains or rolling deployments can take all replicas offline simultaneously. Critical for production banking workloads.
features.remediation: Generate PodDisruptionBudget with minAvailable:1 (or 50% for multi-replica) for each Deployment/StatefulSet. Add test_pdb_generated_for_multi_replica_deployment.

features.substep: Pod affinity and anti-affinity — preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution spread across nodes
features.blocking_gap: No pod anti-affinity generated. All replicas of a Deployment may schedule on the same node, risking single-node failure taking the whole service down.
features.remediation: Add preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution anti-affinity (hostname topology key) to all multi-replica Deployments/StatefulSets. Add test.

features.substep: TopologySpreadConstraints — zone-level spreading for high-availability
features.blocking_gap: No TopologySpreadConstraints. Pods may concentrate in a single availability zone.
features.remediation: Add TopologySpreadConstraints (kubernetes.io/zone, maxSkew:1, whenUnsatisfiable:ScheduleAnyway) to multi-replica Deployments and StatefulSets.

features.substep: nodeSelector and tolerations — optional per-component node targeting
features.blocking_gap: No nodeSelector or tolerations. GPU/storage-optimized/spot node pools cannot be targeted from bundle metadata.
features.remediation: Add optional nodeSelector and tolerations fields to workload payload; pass through to pod spec when present.

features.substep: KEDA ScaledObject — optional event-driven autoscaling (queue depth, Prometheus metric)

features.blocking_gap: KEDA ScaledObject not generated. Queue-driven worker components cannot scale based on queue depth.
features.remediation: When workload targetForm includes KEDA config, generate keda.sh/v1alpha1 ScaledObject. Gate on KEDA operator being present (add to op_names check).

features.substep: VerticalPodAutoscaler — optional recommendation-mode VPA for right-sizing
features.blocking_gap: VPA not generated. Resource sizing is fixed at SMALL_PRODUCTION defaults with no automatic right-sizing.
features.remediation: Generate autoscaling.k8s.io/v1 VerticalPodAutoscaler (updateMode: 'Off' for recommendation-only) per Deployment when requested. Mark as optional capability.

features.substep: PostgreSQL operator CR — postgresql.cnpg.io/v1 Cluster or postgres-operator CRD when targetForm=OPERATOR_MANAGED and postgres in name

features.substep: Redis operator CR — redis.redis.opstreelabs.in/v1beta2 Redis when targetForm=OPERATOR_MANAGED and redis in name
features.test_name: test_flux_preview_generated_without_any_gitops_repo (only verifies dependsOn for redis-operator, not CR generation)
features.blocking_gap: No Redis operator CR generated. OPERATOR_MANAGED redis components have no Redis CRD YAML. Flux will wait for the operator but no Redis instance will be created.
features.remediation: Generate redis.redis.opstreelabs.in/v1beta2 Redis CR with clusterSize, persistenceEnabled, storage fields. Write to kustomize_bundle/{comp}-redis.yaml. Add to kust_res. Add test.

features.substep: RabbitMQ operator CR — rabbitmq.com/v1beta1 RabbitmqCluster when targetForm=OPERATOR_MANAGED and rabbitmq in name
features.blocking_gap: No RabbitmqCluster CR generated. Message broker will not be provisioned.
features.remediation: Generate rabbitmq.com/v1beta1 RabbitmqCluster CR with replicas, resources, persistence fields. Write to kustomize_bundle/{comp}-rabbitmq-cluster.yaml. Add test.

features.substep: Kafka operator CR — kafka.strimzi.io/v1beta2 Kafka when targetForm=OPERATOR_MANAGED and kafka in name
features.blocking_gap: No Kafka CR generated. Streaming platform will not be provisioned.
features.remediation: Generate kafka.strimzi.io/v1beta2 Kafka CR with kafka.replicas, zookeeper.replicas, storage fields. Write to kustomize_bundle/{comp}-kafka.yaml. Add test.

features.substep: Operator and CRD prerequisite validation — verify operator CRD group exists before generating CR, surface blocker if CRD absent
features.source_lines: 21638–21695 (Flux reachability only — checks for operator Kustomization YAML file, not for actual CRD API group)
features.generated_artifact_path: bundle-validation.json (operator warning exists but no CRD schema validation)
features.test_name: test_flux_dependson_skipped_with_warning_when_operator_kustomization_missing (checks Kustomization file missing, not CRD absence)
features.k8s_dry_run_result: NOT_VERIFIED_IN_CI — no kubectl --dry-run --validate against live cluster
features.blocking_gap: CRD prerequisite check only verifies the operator FluxCD Kustomization YAML exists on disk. It does NOT verify the CRD API group is actually registered in the cluster. Generated operator CRs will be applied against a cluster that may not have the CRD, causing immediate apply failures.
features.remediation: Add optional CRD schema validation step: call kubectl get crds {group} --no-headers 2>&1 and surface result in bundle_validation as blocker when CRD group is absent.

features.substep: ServiceMonitor CR — monitoring.coreos.com/v1 ServiceMonitor for each HTTP component
features.blocking_gap: No ServiceMonitor generated. Prometheus will not scrape any R6-deployed component metrics. Production observability gap.
features.remediation: Generate monitoring.coreos.com/v1 ServiceMonitor per HTTP Deployment/StatefulSet component scraping port 8080 /metrics (or configurable metricsPath). Gate on prometheus-operator in op_names. Add to kust_res. Add test.

features.substep: PrometheusRule CR — alerting rules for error rate, latency, pod crash, PVC full per component
features.blocking_gap: No alerting rules generated. Production incidents will not alert.
features.remediation: Generate monitoring.coreos.com/v1 PrometheusRule with standard alert rules (high error rate, high latency p99, pod CrashLoopBackOff, PVC usage >90%). Add test.

features.substep: Observability integration metadata — logging (Loki labels), tracing (Jaeger/OTEL annotations), dashboard (Grafana ConfigMap label)

features.substep: Velero Schedule CR — velero.io/v1 Schedule for namespace backup on defined cadence
features.k8s_dry_run_result: NOT_VERIFIED_IN_CI — velero.io/v1 CRD absent from standard clusters
features.blocking_gap: No Velero backup schedule generated. Data in PVCs and operator-managed databases has no automated backup. Unacceptable for production banking systems.
features.remediation: Generate velero.io/v1 Schedule CR (daily, namespace-scoped, TTL 720h) for namespaces that contain PVCs or OPERATOR_MANAGED stateful components. Gate on Velero operator presence. Add test.

features.substep: External database and VM backup requirements — intent document for database dumps + VM snapshots outside Velero scope

features.blocking_gap: No backup intent document for VM-retained databases or external databases. Their backup requirements are invisible to the bundle.
features.remediation: Generate virtual-machines/backup-requirements.yaml listing each VM component with backup type (snapshot/dump), schedule, and retention. Add test.

features.substep: Kubernetes HTTP validation Job — curl health + smoke endpoint, assert HTTP 200, capture response time
features.blocking_gap: No in-cluster HTTP validation Job. Deployment readiness probe passing is not the same as end-to-end HTTP correctness. Stage 13 execution has nothing to execute.
features.remediation: Generate batch/v1 Job per HTTP component using curlimages/curl image that curls healthPath and optionally a smokePath, exits 0 on 200 / exits 1 otherwise. Write to kustomize_bundle/{comp}-validate-http.yaml. Add to kust_res. Add test.

features.substep: DNS validation Job — nslookup/dig {comp}.{namespace}.svc.cluster.local, assert resolution
features.blocking_gap: No DNS validation. Missing Service or DNS misconfiguration will cause all inter-component calls to fail silently until Stage 13 attempt.
features.remediation: Generate one Job that nslookups every Service name in the namespace. Add test.

features.substep: TCP connectivity Job — nc -z {host} {port} for each declared dependency, assert port open
features.blocking_gap: No TCP validation. NetworkPolicy misconfiguration or missing EndpointSlice will cause component connectivity failures not caught until runtime.
features.remediation: Per dependency pair, generate Job that runs nc -z -w5 {dep-service} {dep-port}. Add test.

features.substep: Database query validation Job — psql/mysql SELECT 1 against each OPERATOR_MANAGED or VM-retained database
features.blocking_gap: No database connectivity validation. Secret contract key correctness and network access to the database are unverified before Stage 13.
features.remediation: Generate Job using postgres:alpine or mysql:8 image that runs SELECT 1 using SecretContract-derived env vars. Add test.

features.substep: Redis AUTH + PING validation Job — redis-cli AUTH + PING + SET + GET against each OPERATOR_MANAGED or VM-retained Redis
features.blocking_gap: No Redis validation Job. Cache unavailability or auth failure goes undetected until application startup.
features.remediation: Generate Job using redis:7-alpine image running AUTH + PING + SET testkey testval + GET testkey + DEL testkey. Add test.

features.substep: Queue publish/consume validation Job — publish test message to RabbitMQ/Kafka queue and consume it back
features.blocking_gap: No queue validation. Message broker connectivity and auth not verified before Stage 13.
features.remediation: Generate Job using rabbitmq/rabbitmqadmin or strimzi Kafka image to publish a test message and assert consumption. Add test.

features.substep: PVC and object-storage validation Job — write + read + delete a test file to each PVC mountPath
features.blocking_gap: No PVC validation. StorageClass provisioner failure or ReadWriteOnce multi-attach conflicts go undetected.
features.remediation: Generate Job that mounts the same PVC (RWO single-writer path) and runs: echo test > /mnt/data/.validate && cat /mnt/data/.validate && rm /mnt/data/.validate. Add test.

features.substep: TLS validation Job — verify Certificate is Ready, check cert expiry and hostname match via openssl s_client
features.blocking_gap: No TLS validation Job. Certificate provisioning failure (wrong issuer, DNS not propagated) not caught before production traffic.
features.remediation: Generate Job that runs kubectl wait --for=condition=Ready certificate/{cert} and openssl s_client -connect {hostname}:443 against the external hostname. Add test.

features.substep: Deployed version validation Job — assert running image digest matches the pinned digest in the Deployment manifest
features.blocking_gap: No version validation. Image mutable-tag drift (registry overwrite) is undetected.
features.remediation: Generate Job that calls kubectl get pod -o jsonpath='{.spec.containers[0].image}' and asserts it equals the expected digest. Add test.

features.remediation: kubectl get hpa/{comp} --no-headers and assert TARGETS is not unknown. For KEDA: kubectl get scaledobject/{comp}.

features.substep: Image upgrade policy — Renovate/Dependabot config or ImageUpdateAutomation CR for automatic base image PR generation
features.blocking_gap: No image upgrade automation. Base images become stale and CVE-exposed with no notification.
features.remediation: Generate image.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta2 ImagePolicy + ImageUpdateAutomation or a .github/renovate.json targeting the kustomize_bundle directory.

features.substep: Secret rotation policy — ExternalSecret refresh interval or rotation CronJob for SecretContract-bound secrets
features.blocking_gap: SecretContracts declare required keys but have no rotation schedule. Credentials never expire, violating banking compliance requirements.
features.remediation: Add rotation schedule to SecretContract spec; generate ExternalSecret (external-secrets.io/v1beta1) with refreshInterval per compliance policy.

features.substep: Certificate rotation policy — cert-manager renewal-before + automated rotation verification
features.blocking_gap: cert-manager auto-renewal is implicit in the ClusterIssuer setup but: (1) renewBefore is not set explicitly; (2) no monitoring alert fires when renewal fails; (3) Stage 14 has no registration step to verify the cert is Actually Ready after initial apply.
features.remediation: Add spec.renewBefore: 720h to Certificate spec. Add PrometheusRule alert for certmanager_certificate_expiration_seconds < 7d. Verify certificate Ready in Stage 13 TLS Job.

features.substep: Drift detection policy — Flux prune:true prevents drift but needs alert when Flux reconciliation fails or is suspended
features.test_name: none — prune:true not explicitly asserted in any test
features.blocking_gap: prune:true is set (drift removal enabled) but: (1) no test asserts it; (2) no PrometheusRule alerts on gotk_reconcile_condition{type=Ready,status=False}; (3) no runbook registered in Stage 14.
features.remediation: Add test asserting flux_yaml contains prune: true. Add R6-10.11-PROMETHEUSRULE drift alert. Register runbook URL in blueprint annotations.

features.substep: Rollback policy — documented revert procedure: git revert + flux reconcile + Velero restore + validation gate re-run
features.blocking_gap: No rollback runbook or policy document generated. Operators have no registered procedure to revert a failed R6 deployment.
features.remediation: Generate outputs/r6-rollback-runbook-{slug}.md with step-by-step: (1) git revert + push; (2) flux reconcile kustomization {slug}; (3) velero restore if data corruption; (4) run Stage 13 validation Jobs to confirm rollback. Add test that file is generated and contains kubectl command.

mandatory_blockers_before_cutover_mobile: R6-10.10-POSTGRES-CR — PostgreSQL operator CR (OPERATOR_MANAGED postgres produces no actual database)
R6-10.10-REDIS-CR — Redis operator CR (OPERATOR_MANAGED redis produces no actual cache)
R6-10.10-RABBITMQ-CR — RabbitMQ operator CR (OPERATOR_MANAGED rabbitmq produces no broker)
R6-10.10-KAFKA-CR — Kafka operator CR (OPERATOR_MANAGED kafka produces no stream)
R6-10.11-SERVICEMONITOR — production systems have no metrics scraping
R6-10.11-VELERO — PVC and stateful data have no backup
R6-10.12-HTTP-JOB — no in-cluster HTTP correctness validation before Stage 13
R6-13-EXECUTE — no endpoint to run validation Jobs
can_defer_to_future_sprint: R6-10.9-NODESELECTOR — optional, only needed with mixed node pools
R6-10.10-CRD-PREREQ — kubectl-level CRD validation, partial coverage via Flux dependsOn
R6-10.12-TCP-JOB — useful but DNS + HTTP covers most gaps
R6-10.12-REDIS-JOB — useful but TCP Job covers connectivity
R6-10.12-QUEUE-JOB — useful but TCP Job covers connectivity
R6-10.12-PVC-JOB — useful but StatefulSet readiness implies volume mount
R6-10.12-TLS-JOB — useful, but cert-manager status covers most
R6-10.12-VERSION-JOB — useful for digest pinning verification
R6-14-CERT-ROTATION — cert-manager auto-renews; partial coverage already
R6-14-DRIFT — prune:true already set, alert PrometheusRule can follow
